definition: Pi is an open-source artificial intelligence coding agent and agent harness developed by Earendil Works.
details: It operates primarily through a terminal user interface and allows large language models to read, write, and modify source code and execute shell commands. Pi is designed around a small extensible core and can be customized using TypeScript extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes, and packages.

explainer.lead: Pi is an open-source AI coding agent and agent harness developed by Earendil Works. It matters because it lets large language models read, write and modify source code and execute shell commands through a terminal interface.

tiers.eli5: It is a program you talk to in a terminal that can edit code files and run commands for you.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers run Pi through a terminal user interface and customize its small extensible core with TypeScript extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes and packages; a pitfall is forgetting that it executes shell commands and modifies source code.
tiers.paperLevel: Pi is an open-source coding agent and agent harness with a small extensible core, customized via TypeScript extensions, skills, prompt templates, themes and packages; it operates primarily through a terminal user interface.

explainer.example: A developer asks Pi in the terminal to modify a source file and run a shell command, and Pi performs both actions.
